a: First question: does it do what it claims safely?
Will a teammate understand this in six months?
Small PRs get faster, better reviews.
State why, what, test plan, and risks.
Label nits clearly; do not block on pure style if CI formats.
Propose concrete alternatives, not only problems.
Authz, validation, secrets, injection, and SSRF checks.
Approve when remaining comments are optional improvements.
